effect: Selects issue writing from a natural request and preserves observable outcomes and the required template.

semantic.criterion: The issue requires the agreed CSV command, exact column names and order, round-trip handling of commas/quotes/newlines, header-only empty output and unchanged JSON behavior, with distinguishable acceptance criteria.
The title describes the export outcome without a commit prefix, and the body uses the required Problem and Acceptance criteria headings.
It prescribes no CSV library, adds no customer email export, and presents the requested work as future work rather than delivered or tested.
A contributor can determine what to implement and demonstrate without reconstructing the conversation; the artifact has no generic filler sections or invented requirements.
